tuning_key.text: Subtle sparks can be sensed between our thoughts
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: There is a living current running beneath the noise of obligation, always there but rarely felt. Today reveals that aliveness isn't something you achieve—it's what remains when you stop trying to become something else. The space between one thought and the next isn't empty; it's where the subtle sparks can be sensed between our thoughts, waiting to appear the moment you rest there.

practice.title: Feel Your Weight
practice.instruction: Notice the exact pressure of your body against the surface beneath you, without changing anything about how you're sitting or standing.

practice.title: Wait for the Gap
practice.instruction: Let your next breath delay until you sense the quiet interval between sounds around you, allowing the pause to expand naturally.

practice.title: Receive the Echo
practice.instruction: Rest in the space where doing hasn't started yet, letting today's echo—the current moving between what you're supposed to notice—find you there.

Your systems become real not through constant motion but through the presence you bring to each transition.
